notes.en: [[character:alice]] gets more Blade Etiquette and much bigger Assault damage from Disorders, so she wants Anomaly partners that apply Anomalies in quick bursts for her to Disorder.
Target stats at level 60: ATK 2,600 to 2,900+, HP 9,500+, DEF 750+, Anomaly Proficiency 330 to 420+ and Anomaly Mastery 184+. Her signature adds another 60 Anomaly Mastery in combat.

Secondary Anomaly DPS partners: [[character:vivian]], [[character:yanagi]], [[character:burnice]] and [[character:grace]]. [[character:vivian]] is the strongest because she deals great damage while applying a lot of Anomaly.
[[character:yuzuha]] is the ultimate Anomaly buffer and the best partner. She buffs damage, speeds up Anomaly Buildup and adds Physical Anomaly Application.
Generalist supports that fit any team: [[character:astra-yao]] (Quick Assists, Chain Attacks, healing and buffs), [[character:nicole]] (DEF shred) and [[character:lucy]] (long-lasting ATK buffs).
The W-Engine ranking was calculated with [[character:vivian]] (Weeping Cradle) and [[character:yuzuha]] (Kaboom the Cannon) as teammates. Percentages are damage output relative to her signature.
